system.description:
Named Unique (maul +3). On a hit, push the target 10ft; if it strikes a wall or another creature, it takes +1d6 damage. It breaks wooden or stone doors and gates like a siege ram.

Quirk (Heavy): it takes 1 more slot. A giant's tent-mallet from the Never-ending War, found near the Giant's Fist; it took three dwarves to carry it home.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
